26|    def _clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
27|        """Return a copy of the current environment with sensitive keys removed."""
28|        sensitive_keywords = {"SECRET", "PRIVATE", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN"}
29|        env = os.environ.copy()
30|        keys_to_remove = [
31|            key
32|            for key in env
33|            if any(kw in key.upper() for kw in sensitive_keywords)
34|        ]
35|        for key in keys_to_remove:
36|            del env[key]

40|        """Start the Core executable as a child process.
41|

43|        """

45|            raise FileNotFoundError(
46|                f"Core executable not found: {self._executable}"
47|            )
48|
49|        creationflags = (
50|            subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP if os.name == "nt" else 0
51|        )

56|            shell=False,
57|            creationflags=creationflags,

62|        """Block until the Named Pipe ``NekoProxyCoreControl`` is available."""
